result.summary: Adds a new libFuzzer harness (`src/test/fuzz/musig.cpp`) covering the musig module's pubkey aggregation, synthetic xpub derivation, session ID derivation, nonce generation, and partial/aggregate signature creation. The harness is built up via CallOneOf branches exercising both structured (generated key/nonce) and raw-byte fuzzing paths. It also adds musig.cpp to the fuzz target CMakeLists.
result.problem: The musig module's four signing functions previously had no unit or fuzz coverage, only an end-to-end functional test (wallet_musig.py), leaving fail paths and edge cases underexercised for a new cryptographic signing scheme.

resolved_concerns: Reviewer found the target aborting (libsecp256k1 illegal argument) on 8/1000 files due to an arm that never generates a real secnonce; author agreed to drop that arm and defer it to #35422 where it would have a guard.

Reviewer showed the raw-pubnonce-bytes design almost never reaches a real signature; author reworked the arm to use generated nonces/keys and feed partial sigs back into aggregation, keeping raw-bytes as a separate arm.
Reviewer flagged a dead length check on aggregate pubkey serialization; addressed.
Nit about alphabetical ordering in CMakeLists; addressed.
